name: pr-1403
title: ScriptHammer #1403: ask for a new confirmation email with no session

steps.say: This video is built from a shot list: one JSON file and one command.
steps.caption: A shot list and one command

steps.say: The change is pull request 1403. Someone whose confirmation link expired can ask for a new one, without being signed in.
steps.caption: PR #1403: new confirmation email, no session

target.text: Link expired or never arrived? Ask for a new one.

actions.msg: the resend control shows while signed out

steps.say: I type the address, let the human check pass, and press the button. The page answers with one plain sentence.

target.text: If that address is waiting to be confirmed, a new link is on its way. Check your inbox.
If that address is waiting to be confirmed, a new link is on its way. Check your inbox.

actions.msg: the page says a new link is on its way

steps.say: An address with no account gets the very same sentence, so the page cannot be used to find out who is registered, and I will check the inbox next.
steps.caption: Same answer for an unknown address

target.text: If that address is waiting to be confirmed, a new link is on its way. Check your inbox.

actions.msg: the unknown address gets the same sentence

steps.say: In the local inbox there are two messages for the real address: the sign-up one, and the new one. Nothing went to the unknown address.
steps.caption: Inbox: two messages, all for the real address
